falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,800 on any day in the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The 73% pattern match to bottom_2024_aug assumed a higher low formation; a close below 4,800 would break the August 2024 structural low and invalidate the bottoming pattern thesis, suggesting continuation lower rather than accumulation

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for 2 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A blowoff score of 43 typically coincides with elevated but peaking volatility; sustained VIX above 35 indicates panic escalation rather than panic exhaustion, contradicting the 'HOLD' signal's embedded assumption that selling pressure is near-term climactic

falsification_conditions.condition: 10-year Treasury yield drops below 3.80% while S&P 500 simultaneously trades below its 20-day moving average
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: This would signal a flight-to-safety divergence where bonds rally on growth scare (not rate-cut optimism) while equities weaken, breaking the macro correlation structure of the August 2024 bottom when yields fell with stabilizing/rising equities

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
